specs.title: Login with a wrong password, then with the correct password

steps.title: Precondition: create a new customer account
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: Add a product to an empty basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Click Add to Basket on the product
3. Open the basket with the button 'Your Basket'
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button in the row of product A
3. Click the minus button in the row of product A
4. Click the minus button in the row of product A again
5. Click the trash button in the row of product A

specs.title: The basket holds no more items of a product than its purchase limit

steps.title: 1. Open the product list and click Add to Basket on the product
2. Open the basket and click the plus button until the quantity is at the limit
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Open the product list and click Add to Basket on the product

specs.title: Pay an order with the wallet: too little money, then exactly the order total

steps.title: 1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and continue
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue
3. Read the wallet pay button
4. Open the order history from the account menu
5. Open the digital wallet from the account menu
Precondition: add money to the wallet so that it holds the order total
6. Go to the payment step again with Standard Delivery
7. Click the wallet pay button
8. Click Place your order and pay
9. Open the digital wallet from the account menu
10. Open the order history from the account menu
